question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**fall**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the given passage is "gardenia flower plant."
 
• **In blank 5 the season has to be mentioned whose quality is opposite to that of summer season.**
 
• **"Fall" is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**
 
• This refers to the season of autumn, when leaves fall from trees.(पतझड़)
 
 
• Example: She is going to start her school from the fall season.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "arena", refers to a place where events or competitions take place (e.g. a sports arena).(अखाड़ा)
 
• Option 3, "climate", refers to the weather conditions in a particular area over a long period of time.(जलवायु)
 
• Option 4, "tropics", refers to the regions of the Earth near the equator, characterized by warm climate and abundant vegetation.(उष्णकटिबंधीय)
